findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be available upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, a sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed in use utensils to be resting on top of hot holding box. Discussed with PIC, utensils were pulled and placed through dish machine. Ensure any in use utensil is stored in a a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(C) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Two containers holding clean utensils were observed to contain crumbs other debris.  Discussed with PIC, who cleaned the tubs and utensils by putting them through the dish machine.  Ensure the tubs and utensils are protected or covered from debris to prevent contamination.

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Dish area to the right of the dish machine needs to be re-caulked.  The caulk present is cracked, separated, or missing from the wall.  Ensure area is caulked to prevent mold and food debris accumulation.

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
CFM’s have not completed allergen awareness training.  All CFM’s must complete an allergen awareness training course within 30 days of employment.  

410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec. 3.07. Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Ice machine baffle contained mold upon inspection.  Discussed with PIC, who corrected on site.  Ensure ice machine baffle is cleaned regularly to prevent mold accumulation.

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Dish area to the left of the dish machine needs to be re-caulked.  The caulk present is cracked and separated from the wall.  Ensure area is caulked to prevent mold and food debris accumulation.

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Ceiling vents in the kitchen were observed to have mold and condensation on the grates.  Condensation may drip on food and cause cross contamination.  PIC called maintenance same day to have cleaned.  Ensure all vents are cleaned and wiped free of mold and condensation regularly to prevent build up of mold and to prevent cross contamination.

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The knife holding rack in the kitchen was observed to have dust and possible food particles on the top where the knife slits are.  When clean knives are put in the knife slots with visible debris, the knives become contaminated.  PIC was informed and the inspector suggested the top of the knife holder be washed regularly to avoid cross contamination.  

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Fans are being used in the upstairs kitchen area.  The fans were observed to have an accumulation of dust on the front of the fan.  If fans are used in a food prep or serving area, ensure fans are regularly cleaned to prevent accumulation and possibly cause cross contamination.  PIC was informed.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A mop was observed in the dish area stored mop head down on the floor.  Ensure mops are stored in a position that allows them to air dry properly.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 (Pf) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.
(B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. 

Upon arrival to inspection, sani bucket being filled up in the handwash sink and was set in the sink for storage. Also observed utensils on the edge of the sink apparently rinsed in the sink. Discussed with PIC. The handwashing sink may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. No filling,rinsing,dumping,storing of any kind to occur at any time. Facility operates on two floors, any of these activities must occur on the first floor only.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed the wall mounted sanitizing dispenser to be dispensing the low-temp chlorine sanitizer at 0 ppm at the time of the inspection. Jug was pulled off the hose and bucket was prepared manually during the inspection. Continue to prepare manually until dispenser can be serviced. 4-501.114  (P) Provide 50ppm to 200ppm chlorine concentration -- prepare according to the label instructions. Reference 4-501.114.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment: The insides of the cabinets upstairs underneath the coffee makers have water damage and are no longer smooth and easily cleanable. PIC states these cabinets are scheduled to be replaced. Repair surfaces so they are smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable. 4-101.19  (C) Non-food contact surfaces must be constructed of a corrosion-resistant, nonabsorbent and smooth material meeting National Sanitation Foundation/ANSI certification for use within a foodservice facility.  Reference 4-101.19.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed an employee turning the faucet handle off with their bare hands after washing their hands. Properly hand wash before prepping any food. The employee properly rewashed their hands during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-510a Employees shall properly wash their hands any time their hands may have become contaminated and prior to handling food or clean equipment.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors in the kitchen to be soiled. Clean the floors in the kitchen.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the coffee spout upstairs in the kitchen area to be soiled. Clean the coffee spout upstairs in the kitchen area.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed four severely chipped spatulas stored above the three compartment sink. Replace the four severely chipped spatulas above the three compartment sink. The manager removed and discarded the four chipped spatulas during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the gasket on the chest freezer #2 to be broken/loose. Repair the broken/loose gasket on the chest freezer #2.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed rust on top of chest freezer #2. All non-food contact surfaces hs to be smooth, and easily cleanable.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed no thermometer in the chest freezer. A thermometer was provided in the chest freezer during the inspection.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed duct tape on the side of the ice machine. This is not a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed food splash behind the fryers in the kitchen area. Clean the wall as needed.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed some accumulated grease on side of grill and under the fryer in the mechanical area. Clean these areas to prevent accumulation of grease.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed partially eaten food on food storage shelf in upstairs storage. Food was removed and disposed.
750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed a light accumulation of mold inside the dish machine where water is dispensed from the pipe. Empty ice bin and wash, rinse, and sanitize this food contact surface. Mold can accumulate in these areas very fast so keep an eye on the mechanisms inside the ice machine and routine wash, rinse, and sanitize to prevent mold growth.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed the plates and bowls upstairs above the steam well to be improperly stored. Cover or invert these items. Bowls can be inverted and plates can have the top plate inverted to protect the food contact surfaces and prevent possible contamination.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a small leak under the front, right side of the dish machine. Repair this leak to prevent water source for pest or mold growth.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the floor under the cook line to have a slight accumulation of litter and grease/food debris. 2) Observed the floor under the dish machine to have an accumulation of food debris around the floor drain grate. Clean these floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed one dented can of mushrooms in dry storage area. Check cans for sound condition upon receiving and return any cans with dents along seams.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
REPEAT- Observed two moist wiping cloths improperly stored in dish machine area. Store wiping cloths clean and dry or in sanitizing solution between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.
